en.vault.title: Account
en.vault.subtitle: Manage your player profiles and Microsoft credentials, pick your skin and check your Espectral identity: Minecraft verification, Discord, ranks and cosmetics
en.vault.heroSelectPrompt: Select an account from the directory to activate it.
en.vault.rosterSubtitle: Registered profiles available for instant launch
en.vault.rosterEmptyHint: Create an offline profile or sign in with Microsoft to get started.
en.vault.avatarUnsupported: Unsupported image ({label}): {name} — use PNG, JPEG or WebP
en.vault.addSubtitle: Add new local profiles or link official online accounts
en.vault.offlineDesc: Create an instant local profile with your username to play offline or on compatible servers.
en.vault.msDesc: Sign in with your official Microsoft account using the secure OAuth device flow.
en.vault.msStep1: 1. The verification link opened in your browser (or open it here):
en.vault.msBrowserOpened: Your browser opened with the code already entered — just confirm the sign-in.
en.vault.msFallbackLabel: Didn't open? Enter this code at the link:

en.vault.clientIdHint: Only needed if the default authentication is throttled or in Azure review.
en.vault.lunarShieldDesc: Espectral protects and strictly respects the authentication token chain from Lunar Client. Imported profiles preserve their session state.
